svg.text: The acoustic sieve on a 12 mm tetrahedron frame: 10 sites, all holding powder
Ø40 µm powder released at random, then moving in one compiled field.
Red rings: the sites. Gold disks at the end: the powder each holds (area ∝ grains).
share of the powder on the shape (within 1 mm of it) over time
10/10 sites hold grains at the end.
Exact glass-chamber fields, 40 tones 30–70 kHz, gravity on; fallen grains are sprinkled in again (1.1 times per grain).
